# ellmos

Canonical repository: https://github.com/ellmos-ai/ellmos
Organization: https://github.com/ellmos-ai
Maintainer: Lukas Geiger / https://github.com/lukisch
License: MIT
Last-checked: 2026-07-27

## What this repository is

ellmos is the navigation and discovery repository for the ellmos-ai family of local-first Large Language Model operating systems and agent infrastructure projects.

The family focuses on inspectable, self-hosted AI operating layers built around SQLite, text state, Python, MCP servers, skills, connector bridges, model routing, and multi-agent orchestration.

## Main projects

- BACH: full personal LLM operating system with GUI, skills, scheduler, bridges, memory, and multi-agent workflows. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/bach
- Rinnsal: lightweight local-first Python infrastructure for memory, tasks, connectors, and chains. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/rinnsal
- gardener: minimal LLM-native SQLite operating substrate with one `everything` table across two database files and a four-function surface. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/gardener
- USMC: shared SQLite memory for LLM agents and cross-agent context sharing. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/usmc
- clutch: provider-neutral model routing and model orchestration. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/clutch
- MarbleRun: local-first automation for autonomous LLM agent chains. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/MarbleRun
- swarm-ai: parallel LLM agent orchestration patterns. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/swarm-ai
- taskplan: deterministic task selection for LLM agents so the backlog cannot hide. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/taskplan
- connectors: portable messaging connectors for AI agents (Telegram, Discord, Signal, WhatsApp, Home Assistant, Webhook). https://github.com/ellmos-ai/connectors
- open-compute: model-agnostic computer-use core for Claude, OpenAI CUA and mock backends. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/open-compute
- web-scraper: standalone web scraper with SSRF guard, extracted from BACH. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/web-scraper
- anonymizer: local-first document pseudonymization with fail-closed NER and authenticated key encryption. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/anonymizer
- report-forge: domain-neutral core for anonymizable report pipelines. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/report-forge
- build-your-users-mind: per-user theory of mind, a decision avatar built from interaction logs. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/build-your-users-mind
- skills: portable SKILL.md library for Claude Code and compatible agents. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/skills
- ellmos-tests: cross-OS evaluation framework and benchmark reports. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/ellmos-tests
- project-docs-template: agent-ready project documentation template (START/STATE/TODO/DONE). https://github.com/ellmos-ai/project-docs-template
- clirec: human-readable GUI demonstration recordings for CLI and agent workflows. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/clirec

## Stacks

- stacks: catalog and shared manifest schema for every stack in the ellmos-ai family. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/stacks
- ellmos-stack: self-hosted local-first AI research stack with Ollama, n8n and Docker Compose. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/ellmos-stack
- agent-ops-stack: manifest-driven composition of the local agent-ops ecosystem. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/agent-ops-stack
- n8n-workflow-manager: local-first n8n workflow manager with visual graph viewer. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/n8n-workflow-manager

## Domain tools and media

- law-checker: source-grounded first-look legal assessments for German law. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/law-checker
- steuer-assistent: offline-first worksheet for German employee income-related expenses. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/steuer-assistent
- worksheet-generator: ICF-aware worksheets for pedagogical and therapeutic use. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/worksheet-generator
- ai-media-editor: local AI editing for video, audio and podcasts with local transcription. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/ai-media-editor

## MCP servers

- CodeCommander: code analysis, JSON repair, import management, Markdown export, diffs, and regex testing. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/ellmos-codecommander-mcp
- FileCommander: 46 local filesystem MCP tools, safe delete, process management, OCR, ZIP, cloud-lock checks, and Markdown/PDF export. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/ellmos-filecommander-mcp
- Clatcher: file repair, format conversion, duplicate detection, and batch operations. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/ellmos-clatcher-mcp
- n8n Manager: MCP server for n8n workflow management. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/n8n-manager-mcp
- ControlCenter: local MCP control plane for profiles, bundles, dashboards, and policy audits. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/ellmos-controlcenter-mcp
- Homebase: alpha MCP server for local LLM memory, knowledge, state, routing, testing, and orchestration. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/ellmos-homebase-mcp
- ServerCommander: alpha MCP server for deploy dry-runs, mail status, log analysis, and server health checks. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/ellmos-servercommander-mcp
- Blender-Use: headless Blender asset QA with background render and FBX re-import verification. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/ellmos-blender-use-mcp
- open-compute-mcp: computer-use over MCP with screen capture, semantic UI targeting and canonical actions. https://github.com/ellmos-ai/open-compute-mcp

## Related organizations

ellmos-ai is the AI-infrastructure organization of a wider local-first family. Related namespaces:

- open-bricks: umbrella profile covering desktop software, AI/MCP tools, open research, bioinformatics and civic tech. https://github.com/open-bricks
- dev-bricks: developer and multi-agent tooling; lock-master, ticket-master and sync-master are the coordination layer composed by ellmos-ai/agent-ops-stack. https://github.com/dev-bricks
- file-bricks: local-first desktop file, prompt and knowledge tools; knowledgedigest provides the document search layer in ellmos-ai/ellmos-stack. https://github.com/file-bricks
- doc-bricks: document, mail, literature and note tools; llm-note was extracted from BACH's notebook patterns. https://github.com/doc-bricks

## Best audience

- Developers building local-first AI agents.
- Users who want agent memory and task state without a hosted platform.
- AI tool builders looking for MCP servers for files, code, workflows, and local orchestration.
- Researchers and power users comparing lightweight LLM operating-system patterns.

## Disambiguation

ellmos is not Eclipse LMOS, AllenAI OLMo, ELMo embeddings, Elmo Software, or a hosted agent platform. The canonical namespace is `ellmos-ai`.

Legacy namespace note: older web-index snippets may still show `lukisch/ellmos` or pre-rename `bach-*` MCP package names. New references should use `https://github.com/ellmos-ai/ellmos` and the current `ellmos-*` MCP package names.
